page-title.purpose: The primary entry point for an article or documentation page.

section-heading.purpose: Major changes of subject, ownership explanations, and next-reading prompts.

mono.purpose: Commands, buttons, terminal material, and machine-oriented detail.

meta-label.purpose: Compact uppercase status context such as prerelease labels.

components.name: Action Button
components.description: The compact Copy or playback action: ink at rest, paper on hover.
components.css: .ds-action-button { background: var(--ink); border: 1px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 0; color: var(--paper); cursor: pointer; font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.82rem; letter-spacing: 0.01em; padding: 0.58rem 0.72rem; } .ds-action-button:hover { background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); } .ds-action-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid currentColor; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Install Command
components.description: A single bordered command and copy action, kept together as the first operational proof.
components.html: dart pub add noir
components.css: .ds-install-command { align-items: stretch; border: 1px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 0; color: var(--ink); display: inline-flex; font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace; max-width: 100%; } .ds-install-command code { overflow-wrap: anywhere; padding: 0.65rem 0.8rem; } .ds-install-command button { background: var(--ink); border: 0; border-left: 1px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 0; color: var(--paper); cursor: pointer; flex: 0 0 auto; font: inherit; font-size: 0.82rem; letter-spacing: 0.01em; padding: 0.58rem 0.72rem; } .ds-install-command button:hover { background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); } .ds-install-command button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid currentColor; outline-offset: 3px; } @media (max-width: 700px) { .ds-install-command { display: flex; } .ds-install-command code { flex: 1 1 auto; } }

components.name: Prerelease Notice
components.description: A calm, ruled disclosure that keeps prerelease limits adjacent to the install decision.
components.html: PrereleaseNoir is an alpha preview. APIs and platform guarantees may change before 1.0.
components.css: .ds-prerelease-notice { align-items: baseline; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); color: var(--ink); display: flex; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.91rem; gap: 0.8rem; line-height: 1.45; max-width: 48rem; padding: 0.85rem 0; } .ds-prerelease-notice strong { font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.77rem; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; } @media (max-width: 700px) { .ds-prerelease-notice { align-items: flex-start; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.35rem; } }

components.name: Terminal Recording
components.description: The single dark evidence component: a source-backed terminal poster with opt-in playback and a direct cast download.
components.css: .ds-terminal-recording { background: var(--terminal); border: 1px solid var(--terminal); border-radius: 0; color: var(--terminal-ink); font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace; margin: 0; max-width: 100%; } .ds-terminal-recording figcaption { align-items: baseline; border-bottom: 1px solid #51514d; display: flex; font-size: 0.8rem; gap: 1rem; justify-content: space-between; padding: 0.65rem 0.8rem; } .ds-terminal-caption { color: #c7c7bd; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.74rem; } .ds-terminal-recording pre { background: var(--terminal); border: 0; color: var(--terminal-ink); font: inherit; font-size: clamp(0.66rem, 1.5vw, 0.92rem); line-height: 1.3; margin: 0; min-height: 12rem; overflow-x: auto; padding: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2rem); } .ds-terminal-actions { align-items: center; border-top: 1px solid #51514d; display: flex; gap: 1rem; padding: 0.65rem 0.8rem; } .ds-terminal-actions button { background: var(--ink); border: 1px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 0; color: var(--paper); cursor: pointer; font: inherit; font-size: 0.82rem; letter-spacing: 0.01em; padding: 0.58rem 0.72rem; } .ds-terminal-actions button:hover { background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); } .ds-terminal-actions a { color: var(--terminal-ink); font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.82rem; } .ds-terminal-actions button:focus-visible, .ds-terminal-actions a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid currentColor; outline-offset: 3px; } @media (max-width: 700px) { .ds-terminal-recording figcaption { align-items: flex-start; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.25rem; } }

components.name: Site Navigation
components.description: Small quiet utility links that reveal ink only on intent; compact mode retains GitHub while ordinary section links collapse.
components.html: HomeDocsExamplesAPIGitHub
components.css: .ds-site-nav { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 1rem; } .ds-site-nav a { color: var(--quiet); font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; text-decoration: none; } .ds-site-nav a:hover { color: var(--ink); } .ds-site-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid currentColor; outline-offset: 3px; } @media (max-width: 700px) { .ds-site-nav a:not(.ds-site-nav-github) { display: none; } }

components.name: Architecture Signal
components.description: A ruled ownership ledger: mono owner names pair with serif explanations, then stack for compact reading.
components.html:
One declarative path, five clear owners.

  1. Widgetsdeclare immutable configuration.
  2. Elementspreserve identity and dependencies.
  3. RenderObjectslay out, hit-test, and record paint.
components.css: .ds-architecture-signal { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); color: var(--ink); font-family: Georgia, 'Times New Roman', ui-serif, serif; padding: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3.5rem) 0; } .ds-architecture-signal h2 { font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 3vw, 2.65rem); font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.035em; line-height: 1.08; margin: 0 0 1.3rem; max-width: 38rem; } .ds-architecture-signal ol { border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); list-style: none; margin: 2rem 0 0; max-width: 58rem; padding: 0; } .ds-architecture-signal li { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); display: grid; gap: 1.1rem; grid-template-columns: minmax(8rem, 15rem) 1fr; padding: 0.75rem 0; } .ds-architecture-signal strong { font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 500; } @media (max-width: 700px) { .ds-architecture-signal li { display: block; } .ds-architecture-signal strong { display: block; margin-bottom: 0.25rem; } }

components.name: Next-Question Links
components.description: Ruled serif questions that send a reader to a concrete next documentation decision.
components.html:
Choose the next question.

How do I run my first app?What does state look like in a real example?Which public API tier should I import?
components.css: .ds-next-questions { display: grid; gap: 0; max-width: 52rem; } .ds-next-questions h2 { color: var(--ink); font-family: Georgia, 'Times New Roman', ui-serif, serif; font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 3vw, 2.65rem); font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.035em; line-height: 1.08; margin: 0 0 1.5rem; max-width: 38rem; } .ds-next-questions a { border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); color: var(--ink); font-family: Georgia, 'Times New Roman', ui-serif, serif; font-size: clamp(1.15rem, 2vw, 1.42rem); padding: 0.82rem 0; text-decoration: none; } .ds-next-questions a:last-child { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); } .ds-next-questions a::after { content: ' →'; } .ds-next-questions a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid currentColor; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Documentation Code Block
components.description: A square dark code sample that shares the terminal evidence contrast without pretending to be a floating card.
components.css: .ds-code-block { background: var(--terminal); border: 1px solid var(--rule); border-radius: 0; color: var(--terminal-ink); font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace; margin: 0; overflow-x: auto; padding: 1rem; }

narrative.overview:
Quiet Signal is the visual system for Noir's browser documentation website. It turns a technical evaluation into calm editorial reading: warm paper, near-black type, generous empty space, and hairline rules establish confidence without marketing gloss. It is deliberately a website system, not a description of Noir's terminal-widget rendering UI, visual language, or native compositor.

The homepage proves the product in a restrained order: install Noir, see a retained terminal frame, then select a concrete next question. The terminal recording is evidence rather than decoration—the one dark anchor in an otherwise black-and-white reading surface. The site uses no gradients, bento layouts, or stock imagery. It ships one hand-authored vector app icon and six reviewed asciicast text recordings; no shipping raster asset exists, so raster prompt or provenance data is neither present nor required.
keyCharacteristics: Editorial serif reading paired with utilitarian sans and monospace details.
Warm neutral contrast, 1px rules, and square geometry instead of cards or shadows.
One reviewed terminal recording as the proof-bearing visual anchor.
Direct prerelease disclosure and question-led documentation paths.

rules.name: The One Dark Anchor Rule
rules.body: On a light page, reserve a solid dark field for terminal evidence or code. Do not create competing dark cards, decorative backdrops, or colored callouts.

rules.name: The Serif / Mono Relay Rule
rules.body: Use serif for explanation, monospace for an operation or captured output, and system sans for navigation. Do not turn reader-facing prose into terminal chrome.

rules.name: The Flat Evidence Rule
rules.body: If a surface needs separation, use a rule, spacing, or the existing terminal contrast before adding a shadow, blur, tint, or floating-panel effect.

rules.name: The Square Boundary Rule
rules.body: A boundary should read as a document rule or a terminal frame. Rounded treatment is not part of the incumbent website's component language.

dos: Do use the paper, ink, quiet-text, and hairline-rule system to create hierarchy before adding a new visual treatment.
Do make terminal evidence real, reviewed, and legible as a still poster before playback; retain a direct source or .cast path where the component provides one.
Do lead a landing page from installation to retained-rendering evidence to a specific, safe next question.
Do keep prerequisites and prerelease limits direct, ruled, and adjacent to the behavior they qualify.
Do preserve semantic CSS variables so the existing dark mode remains an inversion of the same system.
donts: Don't add gradients, bento grids, stock imagery, decorative raster imagery, or a second visual anchor that competes with the terminal evidence.
Don't add shadows, rounded cards, pills, glass, blur, or hover lift to simulate depth that the system intentionally avoids.
Don't use a terminal-looking surface as decoration or imply unverified live-terminal behavior; the recording pane is evidence with explicit limits.
Don't apply this website document as a style specification for Noir's terminal widgets, render objects, compositor, or native layer.
